text: PepsiCo's 2026 proxy statement lists the beneficial owners of more than 5% of its common stock as The Vanguard Group (10.1%) and BlackRock, Inc. (8.2%).
short: PepsiCo's largest holders are Vanguard 10.1% and BlackRock 8.2% (2026 proxy).
